literal_en: Pippū (a parasitical plant that springs after rain) and mushrooms have only 2½ days' reign (and then wither).

source.book: Grammar and Dictionary of Western Panjabi, as spoken in the Shahpur District, with Proverbs, Sayings and Verses

meaning_pa: پپو (مینہ مگروں اگن والا بوٹا) تے کھمبیاں دا راج بس اڈھائی دیہاڑے؛ تھوڑے چر دی شان۔
